title: American Folk Art Museum

services.name: Group Tours
services.desc: The Museum is fully accessible and offers tours to groups with special needs; additional lead time may be necessary to arrange these tours. Self-guided adult groups are encouraged to explore the Museum as individual visitors. There is no fee for self-guided groups. Reservations are required for groups of 5 or more, maximum 15 participants; please make your reservation at least 3-4 weeks prior to your visit. Led by experienced gallery guides and Museum educators, our facilitated exhibition tours at the Museum introduce groups to folk and self-taught art through discussion of themes and historical contexts of the art on view. services.name: Exhibition History
services.desc: Featuring 42 textile works and oil paintings, Madalena Santos Reinbolt: A Head Full of Planets is the first comprehensive survey of Santos Reinbolt’s art ever presented and marks the first-ever solo museum exhibition for the artist organized outside her native Brazil. Best known for her large-scale embroideries made from hundreds of vibrant colored threads, which the artist referred to as quadros de lã (“wool paintings”), the exhibition represents more than half of all known works by the artist and examines the artist’s work through a variety of lenses, including gender, race, and socio-economic dynamics.
